<template>
  <select ref="select" :multiple="multiple" class="form-select">
    <option v-for="option in options" :value="option.id" :key="option.id">
      {{ option.text }}
    </option>
  </select>
</template>

<script>
import $ from 'jquery'
import 'select2'
import 'select2/dist/css/select2.min.css'

export default {
  name: "Select2",
  props: {
    options: Array,
    modelValue: [String, Array],
    multiple: Boolean,
  },
  emits: ["update:modelValue"],
  mounted() {
    $(this.$refs.select)
      .select2()
      .val(this.modelValue)
      .trigger("change")
      .on("change", () => {
        const val = $(this.$refs.select).val()
        this.$emit("update:modelValue", val)
      })
  },
  watch: {
    modelValue(value) {
      $(this.$refs.select).val(value).trigger("change")
    },
  },
  beforeUnmount() {
    $(this.$refs.select).off().select2("destroy")
  },
}
</script>
